units.source_text: 家里有病人，出入的人自然也就多了起来。

en.t: With a sick person in the house, naturally more people began coming and going.

units.source_text: 住在附近的亲戚们三天两头地轮番来探望父亲，其中也有些住得比较远、平时不大来往的亲戚。

en.t: Relatives who lived nearby came by in turn every few days to visit my father, and among them were some who lived rather far away and seldom had much contact with us.

units.source_text: 有的还说：“我以为病得多严重呢，看样子，眼下还不要紧，

en.t: Some even said, "I thought he must be terribly ill, but from the look of things, he seems all right for now.

units.source_text: 说话这么清楚，脸上也一点没见瘦啊。”

en.t: He speaks so clearly, and his face does not look the least bit thinner."

units.source_text: 我刚回来时，家里那么冷清，现在由于前来探视的人，一下子热闹起来了。

en.t: When I had first come home, the house had been so quiet and deserted, but now, because of all the visitors, it suddenly became lively.

units.source_text: 这期间，一直卧床的父亲，病势越发沉重了。

en.t: During this time, my father, who had remained bedridden, grew steadily worse.

units.source_text: 我跟母亲和伯父商量了一下，终于给哥哥和妹妹发了电报。

en.t: After discussing it with my mother and uncle, I finally sent telegrams to my elder brother and younger sister.

units.source_text: 哥哥回信说马上回来，妹夫也说即刻起程。

en.t: My elder brother replied that he would come back at once, and my sister's husband also said he would set out immediately.

units.source_text: 妹夫前些日子曾告知我们，妹妹上次怀孕流了产，这回必须多加小心，以免变成习惯性流产，

en.t: My sister's husband had told us some time before that she had miscarried during her last pregnancy, and that this time she would have to be especially careful so that it would not become a recurring problem.

units.source_text: 所以估摸着是他自己替妹妹来。

en.t: So I supposed he would probably come in my sister's place himself.
